findings.title: Delegated pulls discard the destination failure report
findings.evidence: crates/blit-daemon/src/service/delegated_pull.rs:495-510 converts the authoritative TransferSummary into DelegatedPullSummary without files_failed or failures; proto/blit.proto:645-658 provides no fields for them, and crates/blit-app/src/transfers/remote.rs:613-642 treats any received summary as success.
findings.predicted_failure: A delegated remote-to-remote mirror with a contained destination write failure returns success and the CLI/TUI reports completion without the failed path or reason, silently leaving a requested file absent.
findings.better_approach: Extend and version-gate DelegatedPullSummary with the exact failure count and capped details, copy them from TransferSummary, and classify the result as partial failure.

findings.title: The count cap does not bound the encoded summary frame
findings.evidence: crates/blit-core/src/remote/transfer/sink.rs:193-198 limits failures to 64 entries but does not bound either string or aggregate encoded bytes; crates/blit-core/src/transfer_session/mod.rs:4830-4832 sends the entire report in one frame despite the documented 4 MiB gRPC decode limit at lines 99-100.
findings.predicted_failure: Sixty-four failures with near-maximum path-sized relative_path and reason strings produce a summary over 4 MiB; the source rejects the closing frame and the otherwise-contained transfer ends as a session fault without its failure report.
findings.better_approach: Apply a conservative aggregate prost-encoded byte budget and per-field truncation while retaining files_failed as the exact total.

findings.title: An all-failed reconciliation makes progress appear never started
findings.evidence: crates/blit-core/src/remote/transfer/progress.rs:161-170 retracts files and bytes while recording files_failed, but started() at lines 180-182 ignores files_failed; crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/remote.rs:126-153 therefore selects the manifest-only terminal branch.
findings.predicted_failure: When every sent file fails at the destination, initiator-SOURCE verbose/JSON progress omits the final transfer event and reports only that a manifest was enumerated, despite having sent and reconciled transfer work.
findings.better_approach: Keep the observed-work gate monotonic, or at minimum treat a nonzero files_failed count as started work.
